characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike inimene tüdruk, heledate juustega patsis, kandmas roosat kleiti ja rohelisi kingi. Tal on suured rõõmsameelsed silmad ja naeratav nägu. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: PEETER
characters.description: Väike inimene poiss, lühikeste pruunide juustega, kandmas sinist T-särki ja kollaseid lühikesi pükse. Tal on suured uudishimulikud silmad ja sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kevadine Aed
locations.description: A vibrant spring garden with lush green grass, various colorful blooming flowers (tulips, daffodils, crocuses) in shades of red, yellow, blue, and pink. A few leafy green bushes and a small blossoming tree in the background. The sun is shining brightly, creating a cheerful atmosphere. Cartoon style.

pages.scene: Liisa and Peeter are standing in a vibrant spring garden with lush green grass and various colorful blooming flowers in shades of red, yellow, blue, and pink. A small blossoming tree is in the background. The sun is shining brightly. Liisa is smiling, and Peeter is looking around with curiosity. Both are wearing their designated outfits (Liisa in pink dress, Peeter in blue T-shirt and yellow shorts).

Liisa and Peeter are standing close together in the vibrant spring garden, looking at each other with bright, excited smiles, as if sharing a wonderful idea. Colorful blooming flowers and lush green grass are all around them. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Liisa and Peeter are walking through the vibrant spring garden. Liisa is carrying a small wooden art easel and a box of colorful paints and brushes. Peeter is also carrying a small wooden art easel and another box of paints and brushes. They are both smiling happily. Colorful blooming flowers and lush green grass are around them. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Liisa and Peeter are sitting comfortably on the lush green grass in the vibrant spring garden. They have set up their small wooden art easels in front of them, with blank sheets of white paper attached. The open boxes of colorful paints and various brushes are on the grass beside each child. Colorful blooming flowers surround them. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Liisa is sitting on the lush green grass in the vibrant spring garden, focused on her small wooden art easel. She is holding a paintbrush in her hand and carefully painting a blue flower onto the white paper. Peeter is sitting beside her, starting to paint on his own easel. Colorful blooming flowers are all around. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Peeter is sitting on the lush green grass in the vibrant spring garden, focused on his small wooden art easel. He is holding a paintbrush and carefully painting a green tree onto the white paper. Liisa is sitting beside him, still painting her blue flower. Colorful blooming flowers are all around. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Liisa and Peeter are sitting on the lush green grass in the vibrant spring garden, proudly holding up their finished paintings. Liisa's painting clearly shows a beautiful blue flower, and Peeter's painting shows a lovely green tree. They are both smiling brightly at their artwork. Colorful blooming flowers are all around them. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.

Liisa and Peeter are sitting on the lush green grass in the vibrant spring garden, hugging each other gently and smiling broadly with closed eyes, looking very happy and content. Their finished paintings (blue flower and green tree) are leaning against their small wooden easels beside them. Colorful blooming flowers are all around them. The sun shines. Both are wearing their designated outfits.
